name: Myconian Ambassador Resort
positioning: Myconian Ambassador, a hillside hotel set directly above Platis Gialos beach on Mykonos, with a Thalasso Spa and rooms and suites with private pools or Jacuzzis
best_for: Couples wanting a sea-view room or suite with a private pool or Jacuzzi right above the beach
Wellness-minded travelers drawn to Thalasso pools, private yoga and Pilates

facts.text: The beaches of Psarou, Paranga and Agia Anna and the Scorpios promontory are a short stroll from the hotel's beach.
Glass-bottom boat rides and private yacht charters depart from the hotel's jetty.
The Emblematic Suite sits at the highest point of the hillside, with a veranda and a marble pool with expansive views.
Signature Suites have a broad terrace with a private Jacuzzi, a freestanding bath and a rain shower.
The Villa has eight bedrooms, a landscaped garden and a terrace with a pool and Jacuzzi.
Classic rooms have marble floors, warm wood accents, all-white tones with classic blue, and designer lighting.
Spa therapists work with Elemis, St. Barth and Augustinus Bader products.
The gym includes a Pilates Reformer, with private Pilates and yoga sessions available.
The pool deck has sweeping Aegean views.
Yacht charters from the hotel's launch at Platis Gialos can visit Delos for a private guided tour, then swimming and snorkelling in Rhenia's waters.
Helicopter rides fly over Mykonos, Delos and Rhenia toward Tinos, Paros and Naxos.
Efisia restaurant is set in a stone alcove with sea views.

highlights.text: The hotel is set directly above Platis Gialos beach.
The Grand Suite sits atop a hill with a veranda and an all-marble pool with breathtaking views.
The Thalasso Spa has steam rooms and Thalasso pools with varying temperatures and salinity.
Premium rooms come with a balcony or terrace with seating, a private Jacuzzi or a private pool.
Yoga sessions include sunrise or full moon yoga and sunset sessions paired with meditation.

considerations.text: Platis Gialos Bay is about five kilometres (three miles) from Mykonos Town.
The beach below the hotel has boutiques and restaurants along its boardwalk.
WhataHotel notes high-end pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
